UserAccount.title: UserAccount
UserAccount.description: Player cloud save profile containing 3 character save slots, account-wide soul stones, permanent talents, bestiary/achievements, and audio settings.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the save owner

displayName.description: Display name shown in the lobby account card

soulStones.description: Account-wide permanent currency for upgrading Ancient Ruins talents

talents.description: Permanent talent upgrade levels (atkLv, hpLv, goldLv, critDmgLv, potCapLv)

bestiary.description: Map of mob type name to total defeated count

slots.description: Map of slot1, slot2, slot3 save slot payloads

settings.description: Audio mute, BGM, and volume settings

/users/{userId}.description: Stores each authenticated player's private cloud save profile and character slots.
